mode.model: scripted (fixed JSON steps in the test)
mode.pages: fixtures written for the test; every title starts with [Fixture]; figures are not current official values

realProviderResults.reason: Not run: the deployment hold and paused manual testing (28 Oct). A real run would spend from the shared money and search limits (/day, 0/month; 10/100 public searches), which stay unchanged. When allowed, run each question once and report each run on its own, not as a benchmark.

whatThisProves: What the code refuses or keeps for each case, whatever the model proposes. It does not measure how often a real model proposes the wrong reply, or the quality of real search results.
knownLimits: A reply that cites only one side of a disagreement between official sources still passes (uk-conflict-two-official-levels); surfacing conflicts stays the model’s job.
Jurisdiction inside the UAE (one emirate’s rule for another) is checked only for schools (SPEA vs others), not in general.
Nation detection uses page addresses only: gov.uk pages that apply to England alone are treated as UK-wide.
